title: OP GUI REVAMP
features:
we're back! completely rewrote the script for demo 4, please let me know of bugs since this was all written fairly quickly (like 3 days)

keep in mind, you MUST enable training wheels for auto guard to work. 

this script has a lot of customizable delays, you WILL need to use trial and error to figure out what works for you.

tested on visual executor 5/31/2025

AUTO ACTIONS
AUTO GUARD - WITH CUSTOMIZABLE DELAY
AUTO SWORD ATTACK - WITH CUSTOMIZABLE DELAY
AUTO SUPERBALL WITH ENEMY TARGET SELECTOR AND CUSTOMIZABLE DELAY
AUTO DYNAMITE/SLINGSHOT ATTACK
AUTO LAUNCHER ATTACK
AUTO LINEBOUNCE ATTACK

COLLECTIBLES
ITEM TELEPORTER DROPDOWN
CARD TELEPORTER DROPDOWN
BUX TELEPORTER DROPDOWN

MISC
GODMODE (INVINCIBILITY)
AUTO FISH
TOGGLE NOTIFICATIONS
TOGGLE DEBUG MESSAGES
SPEED BOOST SLIDER

update #1 (v1.0.1):
added toggle notifications
fixed some small bugs & removed action delay from auto superball

update #2 (v1.5):
added auto linebounce (EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE, COULD HAVE BUGS)
added auto fish
added configuration saving
added speed boost slider (to travel faster)
added disable debug messages
added a system to notify you when items/cards/bux is in the room
fixed some bugs (forgot what they were)

update #3 (v1.75) 
added use sword on flying enemies
added unlock premium/donator only animation flavors
added teleport back to original position for collectible tp
fixed notifications
